name: Lövhult - Ränneborg
description: Lövhult to Ränneborg. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Svartåns källa: Official source/spring and early tributary of Svartån, marked as drinking water and attraction.
notes: Official structured facts/API length is 24.1 km, while official prose says 23.7 km. Official GPX computes to 24.076949 km.
Naturkartan API assigns HÖ16 to Nässjö municipality, but official prose says the route ends at Ränneborg in Eksjö and the next HÖ17 stage is assigned to Eksjö.
OSM relation 15422103 is tagged Lövhult-Eksjö and overlaps HÖ16 but extends beyond official Ränneborg endpoint.
Official Smålandsleden text says bus access via stop 'Ränneborg', while current JLT/GTFS evidence found Eksjö Ränneslätt as the closest confirmed useful stop.
Official sources map Svartåns källa as drinking water, but facility/rules lanes found flow and water quality vary seasonally and current potability/treatment/sampling were not confirmed.
Official HÖ16 text names Fiskaretorpsåsen as a highlight, but the Visit Eksjö coordinate interpreted by facilities lane lies east of the Ränneborg endpoint and was not reconciled with HÖ16 GPX.

facilities.description: Official HÖ15/HÖ16 trail entrance and Lövhult service cluster. Official categories include camping, drinking water, shelter, fireplace, entrance and parking; description mentions large parking, camping, kiosk and water refill.

facilities.description: Official parking in the Lövhult HÖ15/HÖ16 cluster.

facilities.name: Svartåns källa
facilities.description: Official source/spring and early tributary of Svartån, marked as drinking water and attraction.

facilities.name: Hackareviken nature reserve parking/rest access
facilities.description: Nature reserve crossed by Höglandsleden. Official facilities include parking, information board, rest area and marked trail. Länsstyrelsen says a picnic/rest place is near the trail junction about 250 m from parking.

facilities.name: Hackareviken picnic/rest point
facilities.description: Picnic/rest point inside Hackareviken near the marked trail junction.

facilities.name: Borgmästarängen wind shelters
facilities.description: Two wind shelters at the north end of Norra Vixen, about four persons each, with official grillplace and small parking context.

facilities.name: Borgmästarängen entrance/rest area
facilities.description: Official HÖ16 entrance/rest area by Norra Vixen. Sources list table groups, grillplace, woodshed, waste bin, parking for about ten cars and dry toilet at the parking entrance. Visit Eksjö also confirms shelters, covered grillplace, activity course, fishing jetty and canoe/kayak launch.

facilities.name: Ränneborg, ledentré HÖ16/HÖ17
facilities.description: Official HÖ16/HÖ17 endpoint entrance at Ränneborgs Idrottsplats. Parking is available; official text mentions bus access.
